meta.description: Forty years, twenty rounds. Get rich, get status, get out.

guide.title: Guide
guide.news: Every round opens with the news. Each headline hints at the next two years, and not all of them come true. Read them before you put your money anywhere.
guide.cards: Life deals you a few cards every round. Each choice shows what it costs and what it brings before you pick, with the odds where there are dice. A choice cannot be taken back.
guide.finance: Now your money. Nothing here happens until you play the round, and the line above the button tells you, to the dollar, the cash you will have afterwards. Start in Portfolio.
guide.ledger: Two years went by. This is everything that came in and went out. Prices moved after you played, so what you own is worth something new.
guide.ratRace: The bar at the top is the whole game: your passive income against what your life costs. Cover the cost two rounds running and you are out of the rat race.
guide.invest: Cash earns nothing. Savings pay a little and are safe. The Market tab has index funds, which anyone can buy, and more opens up as your finance skill grows.
guide.focus: The Lifestyle tab holds your focus: study for a promotion, work overtime for pay now, or look for a better job. Use it every round.
guide.flow: Flow, at the top, is what you earn less what you spend in a year, before tax. The Taxes tab shows this round to the dollar.

news.title: News
news.hint: Headlines are about the next two years.
news.opener: The headlines beside this are about the next two years.

crisis.label: Crisis · year {year} of {of}
crisis.open: {crisis}: year {year} of {of}. See what it is.
crisis.advice: A crisis punishes whoever has to sell and whoever owes a lot. Those who hold usually get some of it back on the way out.
crisis.overHint: The world is back on its course. What fell does not rise by itself: see what you have left.

escape.title: Out of the rat race!
escape.body: At {age}, your income pays for your whole life without you. From today, work is a choice.
escape.hint: The earlier you get out, the bigger the bonus on your score. If your income stops covering your life, the wheel turns again.
escape.go: Carry on, for the fun of it

million.title: Your first million
million.body: At {age} you are worth a million real dollars: the kind that bought the same when you started.
million.hint: The second usually comes sooner than the first.

bankrupt.title: Bankrupt
bankrupt.body: At {age} your debts have beaten you. Everything you owned is sold and everything you owed is cancelled.
bankrupt.hint: No bank will lend to you until you are {age}. Your pension plan is untouched. Life goes on.

plans.missed: No cash for it this round: it will not buy
plans.editHint: It buys when each round is played, after your own orders. If a round has no cash for it, it does not buy that once: it never borrows for you.

profile.title: Your life
profile.leaveHint: Your life is saved after every step.
profile.itemWhen: It is sold or cancelled during the finances: here or in the Shop tab.
profile.itemUndo: It takes effect when the round is played. Until then you can take it out of the basket.
profile.aboutLifestyle: Your lifestyle multiplies what living costs you each year. Living on little shows and takes status away; the top two give it.
profile.aboutRent: Until you own a home in {city}, you rent. A room or a flat changes what you spend and your status.
profile.rentCost: The cost is that of your whole life with that rent, at the lifestyle you lead.
profile.aboutInsurance: You pay a premium every year. In return, when a bad card comes, the insurance pays part of the bill.
profile.changedIn: It is changed during the finances: here or in the Lifestyle tab.
profile.pickHere: Tap to choose. It takes effect when the round is played.

cash.title: Cash
cash.about: The money you have on hand. Your expenses, your purchases and your taxes come out of it.
cash.note: It earns nothing, and inflation eats it. Keep what the round needs and put the rest to work.

savings.title: Savings
savings.about: A deposit with no risk. It pays interest that follows the central bank's rate.
savings.note: If you ever run short of cash, the game takes it from here first, before it goes on the credit card.

pension.title: Pension plan
pension.about: Money put aside for the end. What you pay in lowers that round's tax.
pension.note: It cannot be touched before then, whatever happens. A bankruptcy does not take it either, and it counts in your net worth.

investments.title: Investments
investments.about: What you hold in the markets, at today's price.
investments.none: You have no investments yet. They are bought in the Market tab.
investments.note: The gain is over what you paid. When you sell, the taxman takes his share of it.

homes.title: Property
homes.about: Your properties, at what they are worth today. The mortgage on each is counted apart, under Debts.
homes.note: They are sold and let in the Property tab.

things.title: Things
things.about: What you own, at what you would get for it today. Tap one to look at it.
things.note: Nearly everything loses value each year. A few watches, bags and works of art hold it or gain.

debts.title: Debts
debts.about: Everything you owe. Each round you pay interest and repay a part.
debts.note: The credit card is the dearest and has no term: it fills by itself when cash runs short. Clear it first.

netWorth.title: Net worth
netWorth.about: Everything you own less everything you owe. It is half your score; the other half is status.

end.title: The end
end.statusHint: Status counts as you lived it: the average over the whole life.
end.never: You never left the rat race.

epilogue.quiet: It was a quiet life: no moves, no shocks and no big bets. Year after year, the same, and on time.
